summary: Session 1 of 1 (one-session set; Phase 4 F1.5). Introduced `VbaModuleBodyLoader` (`Load` + `LoadAndParse`) under `AccessHarvester.Vba.Parser/` that strips the canonical leading VBA module-header block (VERSION/BEGIN..END/Attribute VB_* coupled per R1 fix) and captures it as typed `ModuleHeaderMetadata` attached to a new init-only `Header` property on the `Module` AST. Routed the two production VBA-parsing call sites through the loader: `SymbolDbBuilder` (LoadAndParse) and `ParseSuccessReportGenerator` (two-step Load + Parse — workaround for the pre-existing AstBuilder NRE documented in audit.md Follow-up Finding 1). Regenerated parse-success-report goldens: HHC parseOk 3 → 30 / 32 (94%); Northwind 14 → 61 / 66 (92%); both hit the spec's Stop-Rule thresholds (HHC ≥30; NW ≥60). Loader unit tests (15/15) + end-to-end regression test on a previously-failing HHC code-behind module (Form_frmReportParam_FY); full suite 1869 passed, 2 skipped. Cross-provider verification ran 3 rounds against gpt-5-4: R1 found 1 Major (VERSION/BEGIN coupling) + 1 Minor (audit.md P2 description), both fixed; R2 raised an out-of-scope AstBuilder NRE due to dropped OOS disclaimer; R3 with reshaped context returned VERIFIED. Closeout artifacts: change-log.md (gemini-flash summarization, max_tier=1), next-session-set-recommendation.md (gemini-pro analysis), ai-assignment.md actuals appended, this disposition.json written before the closeout commit per Convention. SET COMPLETE.
